title: I wonder if there is a reason
content: I just discovered this sub and I’m honestly speechless after reading lots of posts and comments. Although a lot of us have different visual descriptions, they ALL seem to be at the same selection of places.. airport, shopping mall, hotel lobby, train station and often all within the same “dream session”. I don’t know if I believe In astral projection or shared viewing or whatever (not saying I don’t believe , I just don’t know enough about it). But I find it mind blowing that these recurring dream locations are so common and I just wonder why. The sense I get in the dreams is often that I’m trying to get to somewhere but there are thing always holding me back… either big crowds or I have lost my passport or have lost my money or something. It always feels like I’m being held back … I’m often frequenting this same hotel but can only really go into the lobby and can’t afford to get a room there or go to the bar/restaurant there, although sometimes I get a coffee there. There are always liminal spaces … stairwells, lifts that go so fast that the smash into the roof, or just go up and up infinitely, long corridors, places that seem to either loop or just go on forever. Usually I’m trying to get away from someone or get to somewhere in a rush but never make it. Sometimes I’m stuck somewhere. Time always seems to be an issue. So I’m just wondering if maybe there are reasons that we all share in our waking lives that result in us dreaming about these types of locations. I guess in my normal waking life I feel like my life is at a stage similar to how I feel in a liminal space. Like I can see where I need or want to be but something is always holding me back (usually money and confidence). What do you think? Is this relatable?
